an6.80:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu
an6.80:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ālokabahulo ca hoti yogabahulo ca hoti vedabahulo ca hoti asantuṭṭhibahulo ca anikkhittadhuro ca kusalesu dhammesu uttariñca patāreti
an6.80:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesūti. 81
